exam_scheme.note: Selection process consists of: (1) Written Examination comprising 150 objective MCQs (600 marks, 2 hours 15 minutes, +4, -1) across General Studies, Science/Maths, and Reasoning to shortlist candidates in a 1:5 ratio; and (2) Practical Skill Test comprising Hindi Shorthand (80 wpm for 5 minutes, 20 minutes transcription, max 10% errors), Hindi Typing (30 wpm for 10 minutes, max 1.5% errors), and basic computer operating proficiency. Final merit is prepared based on written examination marks of candidates who qualify the skill test.

financial_package.note: Stenographers and Instructor Stenographers are appointed in Pay Matrix Level 4 (Entry Basic ₹25,500 – ₹81,100). Entitled to state DA, HRA, medical allowance, and secretarial allowances.
financial_package.pay_source_label: BSSC Stenographer & Steno Typist Grade-III Advertisement No. 07/25
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 4 entry basic pay of ₹25,500 with standard 58% DA (₹14,790), HRA (8% to 16%: ₹2,040 to ₹4,080), Medical Allowance (₹1,000), and Transport Allowance. In-hand reflects statutory 10% NPS deduction on Basic+DA (₹4,029) and professional tax.
official_perks: Government accommodation or House Rent Allowance (HRA) up to 16%
Medical allowance (₹1,000/month) and treatment reimbursement under state rules
Contributory Pension Scheme (NPS) with 14% matching government contribution
Paid casual, earned, and medical leave benefits with encashment provisions
